title: Flash-Sale Inventory Reservation
brief: As a customer during a flash sale, I want to reserve stock for the items in my cart so that I don't lose them while I check out. If the shop can't fulfil my order, I should be told.

steps.summary: Add the inventory types and the 409 out-of-stock error
Implement stock reservation and stock lookup
Add the checkout handler that validates and reserves
Wire the store and route, add tests and README docs

probes.question: Which HTTP status does an OutOfStockError carry?
The shop has 2 pens. One customer reserves 2 pens, then another customer reserves 1. What happens to the second reservation?
options: Rejected: the pen is not found (404)

expected.Flawed: Rejected: the pen is not found (404)

probes.question: checkout receives the body {"sku": "mug", "quantity": "2"} (the quantity as text). What happens?

items.question: A store is created with createStockStore([{ sku: "mug", stock: 3 }]). What does it hold for "pen"?
A shop has 3 mugs. One customer reserves 3, then another customer reserves 2. What happens to the second reservation?
options: It is rejected as out of stock
It is rejected: the mug is not found
It succeeds and the stock stays at 3
It succeeds and the stock goes to -2

items.question: What does checkout return when the reservation succeeds?
options: The SKU, the quantity and the remaining stock

items.question: The checkout route (POST /api/checkout) receives an order for an item the shop does not sell. Which status does it answer with?
